summary: BI-801313EB adds a durable, resumable lifecycle to AsyncInferenceOp and an append-only AsyncInferenceOperationTransition outbox. The migration is additive. Existing rows remain identityVersion=0 and receive a delivered sequence-zero audit transition without invented authority; new admissions explicitly opt into identityVersion=1 after server-side TaskRun or Workroom binding. Provider credentials and unscreened prompts are never persisted. Terminal rows and transition history follow the bound TaskRun or Workroom lifecycle; transition rows cascade only when their owning operation is governedly removed. Migration: 20260904113000_async_inference_durable_lifecycle.

fields.name: identityVersion/authorityScopeKey/requestKey/requestDigest/bindingDigest
fields.reason: Server-owned immutable admission identity and digests make replay idempotent without storing credentials or trusting client scope.
fields.provenance: Derived by the authorized admission boundary from the authenticated TaskRun or Workroom binding and canonical screened request.

fields.name: taskRunId/workroomId
fields.reason: Exactly one existing governed work carrier owns each version-one operation; database constraints reject zero or multiple owners.
fields.provenance: Resolved server-side from authenticated execution authority before persistence; foreign keys reference TaskRun or Workroom.

fields.name: checkpointSequence/transitionSequence/startClaimFence
fields.reason: Monotonic counters fence concurrent workers, provider starts, and transition delivery.
fields.provenance: Advanced transactionally by the durable operation store under compare-and-swap conditions.

fields.name: startAttemptedAt/leaseOwner/leaseExpiresAt/cancelRequestedAt/nextPollAt/updatedAt
fields.reason: Operational lifecycle timestamps and opaque worker lease identity support recovery, cancellation, and bounded polling.
fields.provenance: Written by the server-owned admission, worker, cancellation, and recovery paths using the database clock.

fields.name: requestContext/resultText/resultData/errorMessage/progressPct/progressMessage
fields.reason: Only normalized credential-free request context and sanitized provider outcomes are retained; raw secret-bearing payloads are rejected or stripped.
fields.provenance: Produced by credential screening and provider-specific normalization before the transactional store write.

fields.name: operationId/sequence/status
fields.reason: Each immutable ordered transition belongs to one operation and uses the same closed lifecycle vocabulary.
fields.provenance: Created transactionally with the owning AsyncInferenceOp state transition; legacy rows receive one explicitly delivered sequence-zero boundary.

fields.name: checkpoint/occurredAt/deliveryAttempts/deliveredAt
fields.reason: Sanitized checkpoints and delivery metadata provide an auditable transactional outbox without duplicating business authority.
fields.provenance: Written by the durable transition store and updated by the bounded outbox dispatcher.
